conf.description: Arkime full-packet capture viewer-history / api-pull: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: arkime / viewer-history / api-pull. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (custom logs-arkime.history ingest pipeline). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
